title: Dynamic Distribution-Aware Uncertainty Tracking in Vision-Language Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.09011v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) aims to measure the reliability of model predictions, serving as a critical safeguard for deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in safety-critical scenarios. Post-hoc approaches are widely adopted due to their lightweight nature, mapping the outputs of VLMs to uncertainty measures through learnable modules or inductive summarization. However, Post-hoc approaches remain inherently confined to fitting the failure patterns of the source domain, ignoring the dynamic nature of test distributions. To address this challenge, we propose a Dynamic Distribution-Aware Uncertainty Quantification framework (DDA-UQ) that shifts the paradigm from static mapping to a dynamic distribution-aware process. translated_title: 视觉-语言表示学习中的动态分布感知不确定性跟踪
translated_abstract: 不确定性量化（UQ）旨在衡量模型预测的可靠性，是部署视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在安全关键场景中的关键保障。后处理方法因其轻量性而被广泛采用，通过可学习模块或归纳总结将VLMs的输出映射到不确定性度量。然而，后处理方法本质上局限于拟合源域的失败模式，忽视了测试分布的动态性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种动态分布感知不确定性量化框架（DDA-UQ），将范式从静态映射转变为动态分布感知过程。在训练期间，我们利用高斯混合模型对视觉-语言模型的嵌入空间进行建模并提取分布证据，从而动态推导不确定性估计。在推理期间，该设计动态地调整不确定性估计以适应当前测试分布。
tldr: 本文提出DDA-UQ框架，通过高斯混合模型动态建模嵌入空间，将不确定性量化从静态映射转变为分布感知过程，以应对测试分布的动态变化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DDA-UQ, a framework that dynamically models the embedding space with Gaussian Mixture Models, shifting uncertainty quantification from static mapping to a distribution-aware process to handle dynamic test distributions.
